breakdown.description: The prompt sets the free-end rotation to zero, even though a cantilever’s free end is generally free to rotate under an end point load.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly allows the free end to rotate, computing a non-zero slope θ(L) = PL²/(2EI) ≈ 0.00724 rad, instead of incorrectly setting it to zero as stated in the incomplete prompt.

breakdown.description: The prompt treats the bending moment as constant and equal to P L over the entire span, even though the cantilever moment varies linearly from the free end to the fixed end.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses a linearly varying bending moment M(x) = –P·(L – x) rather than the incorrect constant moment P·L over the full span. The deflection formula δ = PL³/(3EI) and slope formula θ = PL²/(2EI) are both consistent with the linearly varying moment distribution.
